title: Refine Travel Style Quiz results styling: color only the section tiles

requirements.text: Update the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results page so the three result sections (“Your Travel Style”, “Your Ideal Destinations”, and “Your Personal Packing List”) render as distinct tiles with a filled background using the same background color currently used by the “Your Ideal Destinations” section, and do not render a full-width colored stripe behind the tiles.

quotes: Use the background color of Your Ideal Destinations
I want only the sections to have the color not the entire stripe behind it
I said border but i ment actually the tile, all tiles can have the travelbutts background color

acceptanceCriteria: On the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results screen, there is no full-width colored band/stripe behind any of the three result sections.
Each of the three result sections is visually presented as a tile/card with a filled background color matching the “Your Ideal Destinations” section background color.
The tile background color is applied to the tile/card itself (not the entire page width).

requirements.text: Make the borders for the three finishing/results section tiles use the same border color and general border treatment as other tiles used elsewhere on the site (consistent thickness, radius, and overall look).

quotes: The borders can have the same color as all the other tiles on the website

acceptanceCriteria: All three finishing/results tiles use the same border color as the site’s existing tile border styling.
Border styling is consistent across the three tiles (same radius, thickness, and visual weight).

requirements.text: Adjust the quiz page-level background styling so the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results screen does not appear as a single full-page colored block; ensure only the tiles carry the “Your Ideal Destinations” background color.

quotes: i want only the sections to have the color not the entire stripe behind it

acceptanceCriteria: The finishing/results screen background behind the tiles is not the same filled brand/section color; instead, the color is confined to the tiles.
Spacing/padding around the tiles remains clean and consistent after the background change.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any path listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep all changes within the existing React + TypeScript + Tailwind setup; no new backend canisters or external services.
nonGoals: No changes to quiz questions, scoring logic, destinations data, or story generation.
No redesign of other pages beyond what is necessary to achieve the tile-only background styling on the Travel Style Quiz finishing/results UI.
